newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bakrie Brothers launches US$100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie Brothers launches US$100 mln FRN.

text.p: The following issue was announced by Peregrine Fixed Income.

LONDON AND FRANKFURT.
